name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 16 Bringing It All Together
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Course wrap-up: recap of the core pillars, maintaining results, client expectations and growth.

# Core pillars
1. Fully optimized, regularly updated GBP.
2. Consistent, growing citations.
3. Valuable localized content on a fast, mobile-friendly site.
4. Earned local backlinks and press.
5. Active review generation and reputation management.

# Maintenance rhythm
Monthly posts, quarterly mini-audits, continuous review asks, annual content refresh. Stay current with algorithm changes through reputable SEO news. Expand to nearby cities by repeating the process.

# Client management
Set realistic timelines (months, not weeks), report regularly, document before-and-after wins as case studies, and consider complementary services (local Google Ads, social).

# How this applies to TAG clients
- The course reads as a usable SOP for onboarding a new local client such as [Prestige Plumbing (Hub)](lib:brain-prestige-plumbing-hub).
- Case-study capture fits TAG's existing case study artifacts and [Documentation Screenshots](lib:brain-documentation-screenshots).
